steps.title: Disconnect power
steps.body: Unplug the washer or disconnect power before servicing. Discharge PBA terminals per manual. Replace all parts before operating.
steps.sourceExcerpt: Make sure to disconnect the power plug before servicing.

steps.title: Supply voltage
steps.body: Verify outlet voltage during Boil operation. Check for under/over voltage, shared outlet, or extension cord drop.
steps.sourceExcerpt: Verify outlet voltage during Boil operation. Check for under/over voltage, shared outlet, or extension cord drop.

branches.label: No / fault
branches.oemOutcome: Correct supply — dedicated 120 V circuit; no undersized extension.

steps.title: AC connector / motor short
steps.body: Inspect AC connector for short. Check motor connector for short to ground.
steps.sourceExcerpt: Inspect AC connector for short. Check motor connector for short to ground.

branches.label: No / fault
branches.oemOutcome: Replace motor and main PBA if motor shorted; PBA only if motor clean.

steps.title: Replace motor and/or PBA
steps.oemOutcome: Replace shorted motor and PBA per §4-1 9C1/9C2.

steps.title: Power path OK
steps.oemOutcome: Supply and connectors verified — replace PBA if 9C persists.
